title: Reply to an email
blurb: Answer emails from the inbox, with CC, BCC and attachments.

steps.title: Open the email
steps.body: Click the conversation in the chat list. The email shows in the timeline in the middle.

steps.title: Switch to Email
steps.body: In the reply box, pick **Email** in the channel switcher. Check the From address and the subject line.

steps.title: Add CC or BCC if needed
steps.body: Use the CC and BCC options above the message to copy in someone else, like a business partner or your accountant.

steps.title: Write your reply
steps.body: Type your email. For long replies, open full-screen mode with Ctrl + Shift + E. Attach files with the paperclip.

steps.title: Send
steps.body: Click the send icon. The email appears in the thread straight away.
steps.tip: Emails not showing up here? Connect your Gmail or Outlook in the Guide under **Connect your email**.
